answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the nebula of free entry disappears, the signal of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the delta case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
